name: redirect-to-start-vs-courses
hook: Redirects to / fall through to /start, not /courses
body: When fixing redirect issues for unauthenticated/authenticated-but-no-grade users, redirect to /courses (grade selection) rather than /, because / falls through to /start which is confusing for authenticated users who just need to select a grade.
why: The RequireCourseSelection guard was redirecting to / when no gradeLevel was set, but / falls through to /start (homepage redirect) making it look like the user lost their session rather than needing to select a course.
